about.hero.title: About the Club
about.hero.sub: History, people and a passion for tennis.
about.story.p1: Tennis Club Pazardzhik was built to make tennis accessible to everyone — children and adults, beginners and advanced players. Our facility in the village of Miryantsi was created with personal funds, hard work and immense dedication.
about.story.p2: The driving force of the club is Borislav Stefanov — a veteran coach with experience in both wrestling and tennis, who has dedicated his life to sport and young people. Under his guidance, several players have reached the top 10 of Bulgarian tennis.
about.story.p3: We train children of all ages and backgrounds. Our season runs April – October (outdoor clay courts). Our dream is an indoor facility that would allow children from the Pazardzhik region to train year-round.
about.coach1.name: Borislav Stefanov
about.coach1.bio: Veteran coach with a long career in wrestling and tennis. Several of his players have reached the top 10 of Bulgarian tennis rankings.
about.coach2.name: Silvia Botusharova
about.coach2.bio: Club organiser and the face of the club. Manages daily operations and communicates with parents, institutions and partners.
about.coach3.name: Junior Coaches
about.coach3.bio: Group training sessions for children every Tuesday and Thursday at 18:30. Open to ages 4 to 16.
